messages:
maria: noticed a spike in 429s for org org-8472, starting ~09:07 UTC. looks like requests are being clipped.
kevin: where? dashboards show org quota ok? link: https://console/redwood/quotas/org-8472
maria: dashboard shows quota 1.5k/s but logs show rejects at 500/s
jia: deploying a change to fallback routing yesterday, could be related. pinging @ops-bot for recent config rolls
ops-bot: deploy: config-service v2.14.1 applied to staging,prod at 2026-03-18T08:45:12Z by kevin
maria: thanks. is there a propagation step that converts per-org -> per-key limits? maybe translation bug
kevin: grabbing logs. I see translation service emitted `effective_limit=500` for org-8472 at eval step
kevin: config-service shows org quota 1500 in source-of-truth
jia: ah — translation has a "sticky fallback" where if a per-key rollout flag is missing we default to last-known per-key bucket. Might be sticky from a canary test
maria: that would explain why some tokens get 500 and others 1500. need quick mitigation
sre-oncall: can we short-circuit translation by forcing explicit effective_limit recompute? I can run a one-off job
kevin: please do. running: `curl -XPOST https://config/internal/recompute?org=org-8472` -> 202 Accepted
ops-bot: job: recompute-8472 completed in 18s. logs: `old_effective=500 new_effective=1500 reason=stale_per_key_bucket`
jia: looks like recompute fixed it, 429s drop to baseline
maria: confirmed client telemetry shows requests successful again, +:thumbsup:
product-ops: need a postmortem and console note — customers saw errors without visible dashboard changes
maria: agreed. action items: 1) patch translation sticky-fallback to prefer explicit SOt values 2) add console indicator when computed_effective != source_value 3) add alert on mismatch >=20%
kevin: filing PR now and will add e2e to prevent regression
sre-oncall: leaving follow-up on-call to monitor spikes for next 24h
maria: thanks all, closing thread once PR merged
